coverage_notes:
SOURCES USED. (1) Primary: Clemson's own athletics staff directory at clemsontigers.com/staff-directory/, Wayback snapshot 20181211232455 (Dec. 11, 2018) — captured mid-season, four weeks before the Jan. 7, 2019 CFP title game. Its "Football" department table has 38 rows; football-designated people also appear under Sports Medicine, Strength & Conditioning, Equipment Services, Communications, Compliance Services and Student-Athlete Enrichment Services. (2) Dabo Swinney's official site staff page, daboswinney.com/staff/, Wayback snapshot 20181124131916 (Nov. 24, 2018) — the only source found that names the six football graduate assistants individually and that documents Tyler Grisham, DeAndre McDaniel, Wes Goodwin, Bill Spiers and Tracy Swinney. (3) Wikipedia's 2018 Clemson Tigers football team page (on-field staff only). (4) The 2018 Clemson Football Media Guide on Issuu (issuu.com/clemsontigers/docs/mediaguide_a04593a0a33e02, published Aug. 9, 2018), "Football Support Staff," pages 30-33, plus the Strength & Conditioning page 41 and the Woody McCorvey page 19 — used to corroborate names, titles and season counts. Every media-guide citation carries quote:"" because the guide is published on Issuu as page images only; I read the page scans visually, so no character-faithful text can be copied. QUOTE MECHANICS. On both archived pages a person's name and title live in separate HTML elements (adjacent cells in the staff directory; +

on daboswinney.com), so no single contiguous string carries both. Each quote is therefore a single-cell/single-element string, with the pairing explained in the note. All 100+ non-empty quotes were programmatically verified to appear in the rendered text of the exact URL cited. WHAT I COULD NOT DOCUMENT. (a) No staff snapshot exists between the Dec. 28 Cotton Bowl and the Jan. 7, 2019 championship game. I found no reporting of any mid-season arrival or departure, so no midseason_note is set on anyone — but "on staff at the championship game" is an inference from the November/December snapshots rather than something documented at game time. The Jan. 3, 2019 Clemson championship game notes (rolltide.com/documents/download/2019/1/3/Clemson_Notes.pdf) do confirm Swinney, Pearman ("AHC/STC/TE Coach") and Lemanski Hall ("DE Coach") in their listed roles in January, but contain no full staff directory. (b) Student assistants, undergraduate managers, recruiting-visit hosts, video/equipment student workers and unpaid interns are not enumerated anywhere I could reach. (c) Clemson's own football coaches/staff page was not archived for 2018 — no clemsontigers.com/sports/football/coaches/ or /roster/season/2018/ snapshot exists in the Wayback CDX index. (d) I could not enumerate the strength staff beyond the five named (Batson, Greenlee, Hogan, Smotherman, Dunn); the media guide's S&C page shows exactly those five. JUDGMENT CALLS. I included athletics-department employees whose titles explicitly designate football (Ross Taylor, Brian Hennessy, Amanda Gray, Matt Lombardi, Luke Fieser, Chris Roberts, Danny Poole, Scott Crothers, Abby Dedecker, Abe Reed, Nicholas Yarid) because Clemson itself lists several of them inside the football staff block; each note flags the department. I excluded university/athletics leadership who are not football staff (president Jim Clements, AD Dan Radakovich, broadcaster Don Munson) even though the media guide profiles them in its "Football & Administrative Staff" section, and excluded the three team physicians who are not attached to football (Drs. Bowman, Martin, Murphy) — only Dr. Len Reeves appears in the media guide's football support-staff grid. Paul Harrington (nutrition) is categorized medical; Donna McCain (performance chef), Reggie Pleasent (life coach), Tracy Swinney (security) and the academic/compliance/communications staff are categorized other. Name spellings vary between sources and are noted where they differ: Cam/Cameron Aiken, Ty/Tyler Clements, Josh/Joshua Smick, Nick/Nicholas Yarid, Zac/Zachary Alley, Wes/Wesley Goodwin, Reggie Pleasent/Pleasant, Abby Dedecker/DeDecker. Total: 65 people. No name in this list is unsourced.
